description: The 100 Largest Hydropower Plants in the Greater Mekong Subregion is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Cecilia Springer. China plays an increasingly large role in global energy and electricity sector development through its overseas investment. The Chinese hydropower industry has come to dominate global hydropower development, particularly in the Greater Mekong Subregion (GMS), which consists of the countries along the mainstream Mekong River – Laos, Myanmar, Vietnam, Thailand, and Cambodia. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
